name: agentops-f8e907b9-blind14-ots
instr:
# agentops: span attributes, client bootstrap and session startup all misbehaving, without a test suite

We use a Python library that watches an application's calls out to language services, records what happened, and ships those records off to a place we can read them. I upgraded our copy and the recording has gone strange in a lot of unrelated places. The repository has received 14 separate undocumented edits. Below is everything I have been able to pin down by observation, and the problems look independent of one another, so please do not stop after the first thing you find.

Getting started at all is the first trouble. Switching it on with nothing but an access key used to open a recorded run straight away and hand back a handle to it; now I get nothing back and no run begins. When I explicitly ask it not to open one, one opens anyway — the flag I pass is ignored, and what I get when I pass nothing is the reverse of what I used to get. Opening runs by hand still works and I can keep two open at once, but my counts are polluted by the unwanted automatic one. Adding extra labels to a run already under way is a separate problem: it reports success even when nothing was applied. Hand it a set of key-value pairs whose values are all empty, or a value that is itself a set of key-value pairs, or a list whose items are, and it claims a successful update, while the warning I used to see in the log about nothing usable having been applied never appears.
